svg.title: A portfolio view: every epic’s progress, overdue work and delivery trend — SoftTrack web design mockup (#283)
svg.desc: Which project is in trouble is answered by opening each epic’s page and reading its burnup, and with twelve epics nobody does. A table lists every epic the viewer can see with its lead, progress, target, a forecast from the pace of the last four weeks, a health the lead sets with a sentence, overdue tickets and the last update.
